description: Resets item fields, specified as either names, fields or template fields.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

id.description: The ID of the item to be analysed. Supply this or path.

includeStandardFields.description: Includes fields that are defined on Standard template.

name.description: Array of field names to include - supports wildcards.

path.description: The path of the item to be analysed. Supply this or id.

name: common-reset-item-field
